| | God's Children Are Not For Sale
---
|
---
| | | Peter,
---
My name is Eduardo Verastegui.

I am the producer of the film _Sound of Freedom_ and the founder of **Sound of Freedom Foundation. **

Years ago, I met the people who rescue children from trafficking.When I heard what is done to these children, I asked myself one question:

**_What if it were my child?_**

That question changed my life. And it is why I am writing to you today.

I want to tell you about a little girl. For her safety, we call her "Lola."
---
[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=a2451069843f4ccbb5819afe8dd5788c&_e=Jekf4SaOB3sQjpOc8H3Ncqp11IDbwfc3rWLrfhpxghjhsYwjSE2RTYndJhFhlbUQL4lCj-Au5I6aRndsSKxOGiGZOzFxiQ-xHtPBoX464_Bkp_Dg6WuuvXQ8wGtKHbJoXGvAl2UyOZtxhWmy71ojXEh2GfIzYaGJRFpF9fagnwVNNT6UdAzD1j7fDz44QTJwEV1XUyNhvxB9PR0lYIN6WyBP1XVofWg8GU2sKSgGw4SqThdXApdUV4rF_58qKY2dV8_EISH4_hV5vo0DIYBM26FNtOVcD_3-Syg2DxgLm-nLcs05OYwMtlazYjvj71dqFHaVGUpw2OQ9kE8q7-qFkMrC-uqQ2_w2_4xIiVo4TSSR6FFVf42IInRZg6OOJH2VR6ymMJx6nHlZAMdHPdiyWJqWh8rF2bPHsQQjvS9R87T1mopwNvhs8KGnpdOhRL-QVCLP_Izdo0j4_eVOBOSBz_44Bvf9_iF73UuIp0Wk2Z2m_O4m5thvBEOo3pI2PHw8xMi1fe0ZPg-LlKEp141QBNcTBDNPtHUb_ftijN7W8Yfd4rMpNoMddUuwvch10L_C7CZYWTO-jnSxec3IacS-Wlau7CyW39EnXdLErd1lR5NQ9kfroLTf-20QqKg20au2B_DpTfWGxdxbaIWZVw91LIIMqId77O7NZgikTEeMAmo%3D)
---
Lola's mother was a hardworking single mom, doing everything she could for her little girl.

Then she met a man online.

He promised her the moon and the stars.

He traveled a long way to get them. He said his parents had a beautiful home in California and they would all be cared for.

**It was a lie. **

Soon, Lola and her mother were missing.

One of our house parents moved fast. Investigators believed the family had reached southern Mexico.

So she sounded the alarm.

**She worked with authorities to get an AMBER Alert out with Lola 's picture and pushed her case into the public eye.**
---
[ Sound the Alarm Now. Give Today](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=a2451069843f4ccbb5819afe8dd5788c&_e=Jekf4SaOB3sQjpOc8H3Ncqp11IDbwfc3rWLrfhpxghjhsYwjSE2RTYndJhFhlbUQL4lCj-Au5I6aRndsSKxOGiGZOzFxiQ-xHtPBoX464_Bkp_Dg6WuuvXQ8wGtKHbJoXGvAl2UyOZtxhWmy71ojXEh2GfIzYaGJRFpF9fagnwVNNT6UdAzD1j7fDz44QTJwEV1XUyNhvxB9PR0lYIN6WyBP1XVofWg8GU2sKSgGw4TSPBwYYFn9dYYBg8Mz7yqpkT3KCqC2EWNStT9fzVkzZou25u6MekqQydu3wtgYW8A7BkCDd9Pog2m0tfNSmGBwr57aWw3e_0eZomuupYOLewV9U2oBEtmXo-zP8_411lYtsE1fJpIUy5xcdaQnU-N9lSgIojxFsqYbNbztr7vJe6bIiqXzMgSeo--EzX-qTcfzDnxf824JZ3PCAS1fLz5fjA6Q02wcq_RqADL67_o01DrlTYZ6xKYLybRGM8wT1hawfHxXBZ2LSgAClX5wt8XKoqaIMOLW14nHapXiAK7tvXQAi9C6nSPqbygwz5oK-m5j7urG3soJD5yOOc1pLLw-EzN5q8393jS0vTF_vJD_pZTugM0ZhU73HSS04v5G_pzWDJYX6BP9W47Rho9lxdTPP2YcvNYwTroQdPCb4WcGGE6QfmxADIU3qooACLfqA6g%3D)
---
And that very same day Lola was dropped off and left in front of child protective services.

Alone. Frightened.But alive.

Lola said her mother had died on the journey while she was crossing water. She could not swim.

We may never know what truly happened. But everything pointed to one terrible fear -- that this man groomed her mother to get to her daughter. And that he planned to take Lola into the United States to be trafficked.

**But he did not get to keep her. **

**We stopped him. **

Today, Lola is safe. She was reunited with her grandparents and adopted by her loving aunt.

Peter, this is not a movie.

About two million children are exploited in the sex trade around the world, according to the U.S. State Department.

**Two million. Each one made in the image of God. **

Our nation was built on the belief that every life has worth because God gave it.

**That truth does not let us look away.**

Jesus said, "_Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these._ " (Matthew 19:14 NIV)

That is why **Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists -- **to stop the sale of God 's children. **

And Lola's story shows the most important truth of all: **children are found when people pay attention. **

Here is how you can join the fight today:

1\. **Stay alert.** Traffickers often start online with kindness and big promises.

2\. **If you see something, say something**. Read every AMBER Alert. Share it. If something feels wrong, call 911 or report a trafficking tip through **Sound of Freedom Foundation's** partner, Rescue America, at 1-833-599-3733.

3.**Make your first gift**. Help **Sound of Freedom Foundation** and our partners keep sounding the alarm.

clean_body: A predator promised a mother a new life. Then one alarm changed everything. | | | | | | | | God's Children Are Not For Sale | | | | Peter, My name is Eduardo Verastegui. I am the producer of the film Sound of Freedom and the founder of Sound of Freedom Foundation. Years ago, I met the people who rescue children from trafficking.When I heard what is done to these children, I asked myself one question: What if it were my child? That question changed my life. And it is why I am writing to you today. I want to tell you about a little girl. For her safety, we call her "Lola." Lola's mother was a hardworking single mom, doing everything she could for her little girl. Then she met a man online. He promised her the moon and the stars. He traveled a long way to get them. He said his parents had a beautiful home in California and they would all be cared for. It was a lie. Soon, Lola and her mother were missing. One of our house parents moved fast. Investigators believed the family had reached southern Mexico. So she sounded the alarm. She worked with authorities to get an AMBER Alert out with Lola 's picture and pushed her case into the public eye. And that very same day Lola was dropped off and left in front of child protective services. Alone. Frightened.But alive. Lola said her mother had died on the journey while she was crossing water. She could not swim. We may never know what truly happened. But everything pointed to one terrible fear -- that this man groomed her mother to get to her daughter. And that he planned to take Lola into the United States to be trafficked. But he did not get to keep her. We stopped him. Today, Lola is safe. She was reunited with her grandparents and adopted by her loving aunt. Peter, this is not a movie. About two million children are exploited in the sex trade around the world, according to the U.S. State Department. Two million. Each one made in the image of God. Our nation was built on the belief that every life has worth because God gave it. That truth does not let us look away. Jesus said, "Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these. " (Matthew 19:14 NIV) That is why Sound of Freedom Foundation exists -- to stop the sale of God 's children. And Lola's story shows the most important truth of all: children are found when people pay attention. Here is how you can join the fight today: 1\. Stay alert. Traffickers often start online with kindness and big promises. 2\. If you see something, say something. Read every AMBER Alert. Share it. If something feels wrong, call 911 or report a trafficking tip through Sound of Freedom Foundation's partner, Rescue America, at 1-833-599-3733. 3.Make your first gift. Help Sound of Freedom Foundation and our partners keep sounding the alarm. Your gift helps equip investigators to find children fast, sound the alarm through film and media, support house parents who welcome rescued children home, and teach everyone the warning signs. When good people keep quiet, they become part of the problem. But when good people speak up, God 's children come home. Tonight, a child is waiting to be found. You can be the one who steps in right now. God 's children are not for sale. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. One alarm. One picture. One day. That is all it took for Lola to be set free. Peter, Well, things are getting pretty interesting in Washington already. 👀 It's only been a week since Democrats won back the House, and we're already getting a little preview of what the next two years might look like. **For starters, Republicans just picked Jim Jordan to be their new House minority leader. Yes, THAT Jim Jordan.** The guy who has spent nearly 20 years in Congress, chaired powerful committees, and somehow never managed to get a bill he sponsored signed into law. Quite the résumé! But enough about Jim Jordan. We've got much more exciting things to talk about. **Becca is getting ready to kick off the new Congress, and she's got a whole lot on her mind (and an even longer to-do list).** With Democrats preparing to take the majority, she's looking forward to connecting with new colleagues, building new relationships, and getting down to the business of making life better for Vermonters and folks across the country. That means fighting to make healthcare more affordable, protecting our democracy, standing up for working families, and making sure the voices of everyday people are heard in the halls of Congress. And here's something we're particularly excited about: **We want to bring you along for the ride.** Over the next few weeks, we'll be sharing little glimpses of what Becca is up to in DC. Think behind-the-scenes photos, introductions to new colleagues, updates on the ideas she's working on, and maybe a few funny stories along the way. (This is Becca we're talking about, after all.) name: Marcy Kaptur
subject: One week later
body:
It's an honor to have you on this team

| |
---
Friend, It's been one week since Election Day, and I wanted to reach out personally to say thank you. Every campaign leaves its own memories. What I'll remember most about this one is the people. Volunteers knocked doors on cold fall evenings, retirees and students made phone calls night after night, union members talked to their coworkers, and thousands of supporters like you chipped in a few dollars when it mattered most. We weren't alone, either. All across the country, voters stood up for working families and put Democrats back in charge of the House. For the first time in years, we have a real chance to lower costs, protect healthcare, and hold this administration accountable. I'm proud that Northwest Ohio was part of making that happen. The fight isn't over, and it never really is. But today, I just want you to know how grateful I am. It's an honor to have you on this team. With gratitude, Marcy _[_**P.S. If you'd like to help us start this next chapter on strong footing, you can make a contribution here >>**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143248889/659574422/-1968428927?refcode=261110_mk_ty_l1&ms=261110_mk_ty&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTY1NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YzUyMTRjYy01OGRkLWYxMTEtOTFmNS0wMDIyNDgyNGQ5ZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iPZFIsMxsqxuBR_X7SuHqki3eDAxJ7AmG_EwR4yd7js=)_ | [CONTRIBUTE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143248890/659574423/1039792322?refcode=261110_mk_ty_b1&ms=261110_mk_ty&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTY1NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YzUyMTRjYy01OGRkLWYxMTEtOTFmNS0wMDIyNDgyNGQ5ZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iPZFIsMxsqxuBR_X7SuHqki3eDAxJ7AmG_EwR4yd7js=)

### About Marcy Kaptur

clean_body: It's an honor to have you on this team | | Friend, It's been one week since Election Day, and I wanted to reach out personally to say thank you. Every campaign leaves its own memories. What I'll remember most about this one is the people. Volunteers knocked doors on cold fall evenings, retirees and students made phone calls night after night, union members talked to their coworkers, and thousands of supporters like you chipped in a few dollars when it mattered most. We weren't alone, either. All across the country, voters stood up for working families and put Democrats back in charge of the House. For the first time in years, we have a real chance to lower costs, protect healthcare, and hold this administration accountable. I'm proud that Northwest Ohio was part of making that happen. From: Nick Brown
Date: Saturday, November 7, 2026
Subject: Accountability for the opioid crisis_
Peter –
While much of the country’s attention was focused on Election Day this week, our work to protect families continued here in Washington. And this week, our office secured a major victory.
A King County Superior Court judge ordered Albertsons to pay **$900 million for its role in fueling Washington’s opioid crisis** , plus fees and costs. This is believed to be the largest verdict in state history.
This victory concludes a multi-year case in which our office proved that Albertsons repeatedly failed to investigate and resolve warning signs that opioid prescriptions could be misused or diverted into the illicit drug market.
Between 2006 and 2022, Albertsons pharmacies dispensed more than 641 million opioid pills into Washington. **Our office showed that the company unlawfully filled prescriptions with warning signs more than 6.5 million times without adequately documenting that they were written for legitimate medical purposes.**
**The evidence also showed that Albertsons prioritized profits over patient and customer safety** , discouraging pharmacists from identifying problematic prescriptions and failing to provide the staffing and oversight needed to prevent dangerous drugs from reaching our communities.
The consequences of these failures have been devastating. **More than 26,000 Washingtonians have died from opioid overdoses since 1999, including more than 7,400 in just the last three years.**
This verdict cannot undo the devastating harms of the opioid crisis. But it will provide desperately needed resources to support treatment and prevent future crises.
Since the beginning of the opioid crisis, our office has recovered $2.17 billion for state and local governments. This latest victory will expand those efforts and help communities across Washington continue addressing the damage caused by this epidemic.

| | | We did it. One week ago, on Election Day, voters across the Commonwealth delivered a resounding, undeniable victory for progress, freedom, and human dignity. Together, we voted **YES** to pass all three historic constitutional amendments:

subject: Trump’s revenge: Yosemite, Ambler Road, National Forests still at risk — we need your help, Peter.
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTQwODgzMzUS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjU4MDA1NTk2MgS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Peter, last week, voters across the country sent a powerful message: we want a future with clean air and water, protected public lands, lower costs,
and a government that puts everyday people ahead of corporate polluters. We're celebrating the victory, but need to share a warning:with a short window before the new Congress is seated, this is Trump's last
chance to jam some of his worst policies through. He knows it.There’s already a final push underway to gut protections for many national
monuments. They’re still trying to approve corrupt land sales like Ambler Road
in Alaska, and even selling off part of Yosemite. There's still an effort underway to approve unlimited carbon emissions from power plants. We need your help.Our teams on Capitol Hill are mounting a campaign in the final weeks of this
Congress to stop these policies from taking effect — but pulling it off is going
to take all of us. Donald Trump still has two months to do serious damage to our environment before the new Congress is seated — and we need your help to be ready for whatever Trump and his allies throw our way in retaliation for winning at the polls. https://links.messages.lcv. RENEW YOUR LCV MEMBERSHIP >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/X6bzs~ We ran the most ambitious midterm electoral program in our history, helping turn
out voters in key U.S. House, Senate, and state races. That included a brand-new field program, who knocked on over 158,000 doors in three key House districts. LCV’s member mobilization program rallied volunteers in support of 30 LCV Action
Fund-endorsed candidates in 13 battleground states. Combined, these efforts
included 32,500 volunteer shifts that turned out voters through 1,200,000 door knocks, phone calls, and letters. The results were a stunning rebuke of the Trump agenda. But between now and January, Trump has one last opportunityto force through dangerous, pro-polluter, anti-democracy policies before a new
Congress is seated. We’re already tracking threats to: Overturn critical environmental protections, including safeguards for clean air, clean water, and our public lands, like the Roadless Rule that protects more than 44 million acres of our country’s wildest places from industrial development like road construction and timber harvesting.Open our national monuments, parks, forests, and waterways to polluters, putting ecologically important public lands and wildlife habitats at risk before the newly-elected Congress can act as a check on their actions. Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante are just two of the monuments the Trump administration has targeted, and it has even moved to sell off parts of Yosemite.Hollow out the federal agencies responsible for protecting our environment, continuing to unravel the EPA, the National Park Service, the U.S. Forest Service, and the Bureau of Land Management. That’s why your membership matters so much right now, Peter. Please, renew your membership for just $15 to help LCV defend our environment in these critical weeks >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/ambdF6kea- RENEW YOUR LCV MEMBERSHIP >> https://links.messages.lcv. The next Congress will bring new opportunities for polluter oversight,
environmental progress, and a brighter, more sustainable future.But until then, we have to keep Trump and his polluter cronies from taking
another inch. Our commitment to protecting our environment has to go beyond the ballot box. Renew your membership for just $15 now to defend our hard-fought wins, from the courtroom to the halls of Congress and beyond >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~ Thank you for being such an important part of this work, Peter. name: Sarah McBride
subject: Add your name: Impeach Pete Hegseth
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
It is time we put a stop to this.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=4121%2E21716%2EQHnukX)
For two years, we have seen Pete Hegseth, the right-wing Secretary of Defense — which he rebranded to the "Secretary of War” — abuse his power, undermine the Constitution, and put his fragile ego over the lives of American troops and innocent people around the world.
**Hegseth’s time is up – and my colleagues and I in the House are set to vote on an impeachment resolution _as soon as tonight._**
[**If you agree that Hegseth must answer for his crimes, please quickly add your name alongside mine to send a loud and clear message that he must be held accountable by Congress.**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/em-add-your-name-impeach-hegseth/?source=em20261110-4121&t=2&akid=4121%2E21716%2EQHnukX)
**[Add Your Name](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/em-add-your-name-impeach-hegseth/?source=em20261110-4121&t=3&akid=4121%2E21716%2EQHnukX)**
Pete Hegseth arrogantly and incompetently plunged our country into a new forever war with Iran. This unconstitutional and unnecessary war has skyrocketed the price of gas and other goods that families in Delaware and across our country rely on, and is worsening the drastic affordability crisis we’re facing every day.
Hegseth has shown complete disregard for the damage and innocent lives this war has cost. He has committed war crimes, violating both American and International law, in his attacks on civilian infrastructure — _including a girls’ school_. We have to put a stop to this.
**Voters sent us a loud and clear message last Tuesday that America is ready for change – and that change begins with accountability. It begins with affordability. And that means urgently impeaching Pete Hegseth and ending this reckless war in Iran.**
Back in April, my House colleague, Congresswoman Yassamin Ansari, introduced articles for his impeachment. _I am proud to be one of the original cosponsors of this resolution — and I will not stop until Hegseth is impeached and we end this war._
[**If you’re with me, add your name to put pressure on Congress and send a clear message that people are tired of Hegseth’s abuse of power and forever wars.**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/em-add-your-name-impeach-hegseth/?source=em20261110-4121&t=4&akid=4121%2E21716%2EQHnukX)
**[Add Your Name](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/em-add-your-name-impeach-hegseth/?source=em20261110-4121&t=5&akid=4121%2E21716%2EQHnukX)**
This is an important step towards building a system that benefits hardworking Americans. We cannot let abuses of power continue to go unchecked and politicians continue to take advantage of your tax dollars and hard work.
In solidarity,
Sarah McBride

They demanded real, tangible results: lower grocery bills, affordable healthcare, lower utility rates, and real economic relief for working families feeling the squeeze. If we treat this election as an excuse to celebrate while ignoring the rising cost of living, history is clear about what happens next. The backlash will be swift, and conservative Super PACs will take full advantage. **The real work starts right now.** Our ground teams are not packing up and going home. We are pivoting immediately from election mode into our 2027 Legislative Defense operation. Our legislative majorities in Richmond are the only firewall standing between Virginia families and far-right attacks on reproductive freedom, voting rights, and workers. clean_body: Voters rejected extremism, but this victory is a mandate to deliver. Our organizers are pivoting immediately to our 2027 legislative defense. | Peter, Voters delivered a massive message at the ballot box and unequivocally rejected far-right extremism. It was an incredible, hard-fought victory. But let’s be crystal clear: a victory is not a guarantee for the future; it is a mandate to deliver. Voters did not just cast ballots against chaos. They demanded real, tangible results: lower grocery bills, affordable healthcare, lower utility rates, and real economic relief for working families feeling the squeeze. If we treat this election as an excuse to celebrate while ignoring the rising cost of living, history is clear about what happens next. The backlash will be swift, and conservative Super PACs will take full advantage. The real work starts right now. Our ground teams are not packing up and going home. We are pivoting immediately from election mode into our 2027 Legislative Defense operation. Our legislative majorities in Richmond are the only firewall standing between Virginia families and far-right attacks on reproductive freedom, voting rights, and workers. MAGA megadonors are already plotting their comeback, and they are targeting our most competitive state districts first. We cannot afford to lose momentum. Keeping organizers active on the ground, maintaining our voter databases, and holding corporate price-gougers accountable requires resources today. = | ************=************ Let's honor this mandate and get to work. Peter,
Last week, voters across the country made their voices heard.
They took their power back from the greedy corporations and billionaires who tried to buy our elections, rejected Trump’s authoritarianism, and handed Democrats a new unprecedented majority in Congress.
**Our progressive movement helped make it happen.**
But winning the majority is just the first step. We need a bold, united agenda shaped by the people who made it happen. clean_body: It’s all hands on deck | | | | Derek, Just last week, you helped elect David Crowley as Wisconsin’s next governor. Way to go, Derek! Everything we worked for over the last few months paid off, and I’m so thrilled that we were able to help power David to victory. Wisconsinites helped show that our elections cannot be bought , even when Tom Tiffany’s billionaire backers spent tens of millions of dollars on this race. But, Derek, we’re just getting started. Republicans just saw how strong Democrats are when they come together, and they’re scared. That means they’re going to try to attack us with everything they’ve got leading into the next election cycle, and we need to be ready. There’s no telling how much they’ll spend to try and stop our progress. Wisconsin is a battleground state in 2028, and they know that. | | Peter, Both sides in Alaska’s Senate race went to court this week. Mary Peltola sued to count votes. Her campaign is demanding the state explain every rejected absentee ballot — whose vote was set aside, and why — because in a race decided by roughly 600 votes, a single tray of wrongly rejected ballots could be the whole outcome. Her filing says it plainly: she cannot ensure her voters’ lawful votes were counted without knowing which ones were questioned. Dan Sullivan and the national Republican committee stood up a recount fund on Election Day itself — before the count was even hours old. Add the DOJ’s appeal, still alive after a federal judge threw out its certification lawsuit, and their posture is clear: if the votes don’t go their way, fight the votes. One side fighting to make every ballot count. The other preparing to contest them. That’s the next ten days in Alaska: ballots keep arriving from the most remote communities in America, the count runs to November 18, and the math continues to favor the Yup’ik woman, 600 votes from making it five for five for Indigenous women this cycle.
